title: trqp: test the bridge against verify-trust >= 0.27 (registry/authorization 0.2)
description: tests/trqp/test_verify_trust.py pins verify-trust 0.24.0. Since 0.27.0 (VGI c2a2171, #183) verify-trust asks registry/authorization/0.2 first and falls back to 0.1 only when the registry answers 0.2 with an unsupportedVersion trust-task-error. git-vouch-trqp answers anything but 0.1 with unsupportedVersion (HTTP 422), so the fallback should work, but nothing tests it. Also: 0.25.0+ accepts P-256 and FIDO signers (VGI #177, user-presence flag required), so the bridge's tests should cover those key types; RSA is still refused. Decide whether to serve 0.2 natively (camelCase payload: entityId, authorityId). Latest verify-trust release: v0.33.0 (2026-11-04).
